protocol_or_search_strategy: Targeted review of EFSA scientific opinion 10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006 and NIH ODS Vitamin B6 Health Professional Fact Sheet, accessed 2026-11-14.
inclusion_criteria: Official scientific risk assessments and government nutrient fact sheets.
exclusion_criteria: Marketing claims and non-authoritative dosage summaries.
included_study_references: EFSA Panel NDA. Scientific opinion on the tolerable upper intake level for vitamin B6. EFSA Journal. 2023;21(5):e08006. DOI:10.2903/j.efsa.2023.8006.
risk_of_bias_tool: Not applicable to the risk-assessment document itself; underlying evidence appraisal to be reviewed.
risk_of_bias_summary: EFSA reports systematic reviews of literature conducted by a contractor; underlying study-level appraisal has not been independently repeated for Vitami.
applicability: Safety gate context only; distinguish EFSA and U.S. FNB ULs.
conflicts_or_uncertainties: EFSA UL is 12 mg/day; U.S. FNB UL reported by NIH ODS is 100 mg/day.
A UL is not an intake target or personalized dose.
